en: A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a street view with grand European buildings. Dominating the scene is a building with a tall clock tower and ornate architectural details. Other impressive townhouses line the street, and there are some people visible in the scene. The text 'Bautzen. Bismarckstrasse.' is printed in red at the top, and '4994 Brück & Sohn, Meissen' is printed in red at the bottom left.
